angle: High-risk, high-reward 20.5m pass in the final third that lifted xT and coincided with a Chaos spike — worth a lower-third to explain the decision.

explanation.why_it_matters: High-risk, high-reward 20.5m pass (difficulty 80, success_prob 0.198) by Segun Okafor raised xT by 0.0627 and targeted Kwabena Asante centrally. It coincided with a Chaos spike to 62 (from 28/30/47), flipping a controlled spell into contested pressure and upping immediate threat.
